title: Targeting ZMYND8 unleashes IL-2 signalling to override T cell exhaustion
title_zh: 靶向ZMYND8释放IL-2信号以逆转T细胞耗竭
abstract: CD8+ T cell exhaustion impedes control of chronic viral infection and cancer. This hypofunctional state is characterized by downregulation of the high-affinity IL-2 receptor (IL-2R) and STAT5 signalling, and differentiation from progenitor exhausted to terminally exhausted T cells rather than cytotoxic effector-like cells1-3. The epigenetic mechanisms and regulatory networks that mediate IL-2R-STAT5 signal attenuation and loss of effector-like cell differentiation remain unknown. Here, using in vivo single-cell CRISPR screens of epigenetic factors and IL-2 signalling regulators, we reveal that the chromatin reader ZMYND8 antagonizes IL-2R-STAT5 signals to restrain effector-like states while promoting terminal exhaustion. ZMYND8 expression was upregulated by chronic antigen stimulation, and targeting ZMYND8 in CD8+ T cells promoted both intermediate exhausted T cells and killer cell lectin-like receptor-expressing exhausted T cells. Accordingly, ZMYND8-deficient CD8+ T cells had markedly improved antiviral and antitumour effects, especially in combination with IL-2 therapy or immune checkpoint blockade. Mechanistically, ZMYND8 bound to the active enhancer regions of the Il2ra gene locus that were co-occupied by histone acetyltransferase p300 and suppressed p300 activity. Co-deletion of p300 reversed increased IL-2R expression and effector-like cell differentiation in ZMYND8-deficient cells, suggesting that ZMYND8 represses p300-mediated transcriptional activation to curtail IL-2R-STAT5 signalling. These findings establish an epigenetic rheostat imposing 'signal 1' (chronic antigen stimulation)-induced suppression of 'signal 3' (IL-2 signalling) to enforce T cell exhaustion, with ZMYND8 deletion unleashing effector-like over terminally exhausted states and enhancing immunotherapeutic efficacy.
abstract_zh: CD8+ T细胞耗竭阻碍了慢性病毒感染和癌症的控制。这种低功能状态的特征是高亲和力IL-2受体（IL-2R）和STAT5信号的下调，以及从前体耗竭向终末耗竭T细胞的分化，而不是细胞毒性效应样细胞1-3。介导IL-2R-STAT5信号减弱和效应样细胞分化丧失的表观遗传机制和调控网络尚不清楚。在此，我们利用体内单细胞CRISPR筛选表观遗传因子和IL-2信号调节因子，揭示ZMYND8作为染色质阅读器，拮抗IL-2R-STAT5信号以抑制效应样状态并促进终末耗竭。ZMYND8的表达随慢性抗原刺激而上调，靶向CD8+ T细胞中的ZMYND8促进了中间耗竭T细胞和表达细胞毒性 lectin-like receptor 的耗竭T细胞。因此，ZMYND8缺失的CD8+ T细胞在抗病毒和抗肿瘤效应方面显著增强，尤其是与IL-2疗法或免疫检查点阻断联合使用时。机制上，ZMYND8结合到Il2ra基因位点的活性增强子区域，该区域被组蛋白乙酰转移酶p300共占据并抑制了p300的活性。p300的共同敲除逆转了ZMYND8缺失细胞中IL-2R表达的增加和效应样细胞分化，表明ZMYND8抑制p300介导的转录激活以限制IL-2R-STAT5信号。这些发现确立了一个表观遗传开关，在‘信号1’（慢性抗原刺激）诱导的‘信号3’（IL-2信号）抑制中强制执行T细胞耗竭，ZMYND8的敲除释放了效应样状态而非终末耗竭状态，增强了免疫治疗效果。
